title: Implement Message-ID deduplication check in core
description:
Implement check_duplicate(message_id: &str, storage: &dyn MsgIdStorage) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> that queries the Message-ID->CID map and returns ProtocolError::DuplicateMessageId if found. Called before any signing or IPFS operation. MsgIdStorage is a trait (subset of the full map, for testability). Artifact: core/src/validation.rs.

Acceptance criteria: check_duplicate returns error for known Message-ID; returns Ok for unknown; unit test with in-memory map; calling code in POST and IHAVE handlers uses this function
